43812-through-the-south-seas-with-jack-l.title: With Jack London
43812-through-the-south-seas-with-jack-l.creator: Martin Johnson
43812-through-the-south-seas-with-jack-l.description: A book by Martin Johnson. Through all my twenty years of life I had been in pursuit of Adventure. Many and many a time, when I thought that at last the prize was mine, she turned, and by some trickery slipped from my grasp. The twenty years were passed, and still there she was--Adventure!--in the road ahead of me, and I, unwearied by our many skirmishes, still following.

arxiv-2105-09354.title: Non-cumulative measures of researcher citation impact
arxiv-2105-09354.creator: Mark C. Wilson, Zhou Tang
arxiv-2105-09354.description: Abstract . The most commonly used publication metrics for individual researchers are the the total number of publications, the total number of citations, and Hirsch’s h h -index. Each of these is cumulative, and hence increases throughout a researcher’s career, making it less suitable for evaluation of junior researchers or assessing recent impact.

arxiv-2112-09596.title: Linguistic and Gender Variation in Speech Emotion Recognition using Spectral Features Thanks: This publication has emanated from research supported in part by a Grant from Science Foundation Ireland under Grant number 18/CRT/6222 Affiliation: Munster Technological University, Cork, Ireland
arxiv-2112-09596.creator: Zachary Dair, Ryan Donovan, Ruairi O’Reilly
arxiv-2112-09596.description: Abstract This work explores the effect of gender and linguistic-based vocal variations on the accuracy of emotive expression classification. Emotive expressions are considered from the perspective of spectral features in speech (Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficient, Melspectrogram, Spectral Contrast). Emotions are considered from the perspective of Basic Emotion Theory.

arxiv-2211-01413.title: Harnessing the Power of Explanations for Incremental Training: A LIME-Based Approach
arxiv-2211-01413.creator: Arnab Neelim Mazumder 1 2 , Niall Lyons 1 , Ashutosh Pandey 1 , Avik Santra 1 , and Tinoosh Mohsenin 2
arxiv-2211-01413.description: Abstract Explainability of neural network prediction is essential to understand feature importance and gain interpretable insight into neural network performance. However, explanations of neural network outcomes are mostly limited to visualization, and there is scarce work that looks to use these explanations as feedback to improve model performance.

arxiv-2309-00276.title: Superexchange coupling of donor qubits in silicon
arxiv-2309-00276.creator: Mushita M. Munia, Serajum Monir, Edyta N. Osika, Michelle Y. Simmons, Rajib Rahman
arxiv-2309-00276.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mushita M. Munia, Serajum Monir, Edyta N. Osika, Michelle Y. Simmons, Rajib Rahman. Atomic engineering in a solid-state material has the potential to functionalize the host with novel phenomena. STM-based lithographic techniques have enabled the placement of individual phosphorus atoms at selective lattice sites of silicon with atomic precision.

arxiv-2501-16945.title: ToolFactory: Automating Tool Generation by Leveraging LLM to Understand REST API Documentations
arxiv-2501-16945.creator: Xinyi Ni, Qiuyang Wang, Yukun Zhang, Pengyu Hong
arxiv-2501-16945.description: Abstract LLM-based tool agents offer natural language interfaces, enabling users to seamlessly interact with computing services. While REST APIs are valuable resources for building such agents, they must first be transformed into AI-compatible tools. Automatically generating AI-compatible tools from REST API documents can greatly streamline tool agent development and minimize user learning curves.

arxiv-2502-04985.title: Microscopic description of quadrupole-hexadecapole coupling in radium, thorium, uranium and plutonium isotopes with the Gogny energy density functional
arxiv-2502-04985.creator: R. Rodríguez-Guzmán, L. M. Robledo
arxiv-2502-04985.description: Abstract The emergence and stability of static hexadecapole deformations as well as the impact in the development of dynamic deformation due to collective motion considering quadrupole-hexadecapole coupling are studied for a selected set of radium, thorium, uranium and plutonium isotopes, using the Gogny Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov and Generator Coordinate Method frameworks.

arxiv-2503-05868.title: Metastable Cosmic Strings and Gravitational Waves from Flavour Symmetry Breaking
arxiv-2503-05868.creator: Stefan Antusch, Kevin Hinze, Shaikh Saad
arxiv-2503-05868.description: Abstract Metastable cosmic strings (MSCSs) are among the best-fitting explanations of the 2023 pulsar timing array (PTA) signal for gravitational waves at nanohertz frequencies. We propose the novel possibility that a network of MSCSs generating this signal originates from the multi-step spontaneous breaking of a gauged flavour symmetry.

arxiv-2509-03442.title: Feature-Oriented IoT Malware Analysis: Extraction, Classification, and Future Directions
arxiv-2509-03442.creator: Zhuoyun Qian, Hongyi Miao, Cheng Zhang, Qin Hu, Yili Jiang, Jiaqi Huang, and Fangtian Zhong
arxiv-2509-03442.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhuoyun Qian, Hongyi Miao, Cheng Zhang, Qin Hu, Yili Jiang, Jiaqi Huang, and Fangtian Zhong. As Internet of Things (IoT) devices continue to proliferate, their reliability is increasingly undermined by security concerns. Many attackers exploit malware in IoT devices to launch attacks, leading to large-scale data breaches or device damage.

arxiv-2510-12392.title: Improving Generative Behavior Cloning via Self-Guidance and Adaptive Chunking
arxiv-2510-12392.creator: Junhyuk So, Chiwoong Lee, Shinyoung Lee, Jungseul Ok, Eunhyeok Park
arxiv-2510-12392.description: Abstract Generative Behavior Cloning (GBC) is a simple yet effective framework for robot learning, particularly in multi-task settings. Recent GBC methods often employ diffusion policies with open-loop (OL) control, where actions are generated via a diffusion process and executed in multi-step chunks without replanning.

arxiv-2512-07316.title: Model Predictive Control for Cooperative Docking Between Autonomous Surface Vehicles with Disturbance Rejection footnoteinfo This publication has been supported by funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe Programme under grant agreement No 101093822 (SeaClear2.0).
arxiv-2512-07316.creator: Gianpietro Battocletti, Dimitris Boskos, Bart De Schutter
arxiv-2512-07316.description: Abstract Uncrewed Surface Vehicles (USVs) are a popular and efficient type of marine craft that find application in a large number of water-based tasks. When multiple USVs operate in the same area, they may be required to dock to each other to perform a shared task.

pmc-11456588.title: Force-mediated recruitment and reprogramming of healthy endothelial cells drive vascular lesion growth
pmc-11456588.creator: Apeksha Shapeti, Jorge Barrasa-Fano, Abdel Rahman Abdel Fattah, Janne de Jong, José Antonio Sanz-Herrera, Mylène Pezet, Said Assou, Emilie de Vet, Seyed Ali Elahi, Adrian Ranga, Eva Faurobert, Hans Van Oosterwyck
pmc-11456588.description: Force-driven cellular interactions are crucial for cancer cell invasion but remain underexplored in vascular abnormalities. Cerebral cavernous malformations (CCM), a vascular abnormality characterized by leaky vessels, involves CCM mutant cells recruiting wild-type endothelial cells to form and expand mosaic lesions. The mechanisms behind this recruitment remain poorly understood.

pmc-12415263.title: Genetic Association of Lipids and Lipid‐Lowering Drug Target Genes With Atopic Dermatitis: A Drug Target Mendelian Randomization Study
pmc-12415263.creator: Min Luo, Jinger Lin, Qianwei Zhuo, Lihang Lin, Yue Han
pmc-12415263.description: Background and AimsSeveral observational studies have reported inconsistent associations between dyslipidaemia, stains use and atopic dermatitis (AD). Nevertheless, the available data on the effects of –C‐lowering as well as TG‐lowering drugs remain inconclusive and limited. The aim of this study was to evaluate the causal association of lipid traits and long‐term use of lipid‐lowering drugs on AD risk.

pmc-12475782.title: Poster 65: Adherence of Mesenchymal Stem Cells to Commonly Used Orthopaedic Allograft Tissues
pmc-12475782.creator: Alexis Cheney, Shannon Y Wu, Varun Sriram, Thomas J Kremen
pmc-12475782.description: Objectives:In recent years, biologics have emerged as a viable option for the augmentation of soft tissue healing across a variety of musculoskeletal applications. In particular, the use of bone marrow aspirate concentrate (BMAC) has gained widespread popularity and is used in clinical practice for several orthopaedic indications, including rotator cuff repair and management of focal articular cartilage defects.

pmc-12559453.title: Na2Fe3(SO4)4: A Zero‐Strain Sustainable Positive Electrode Material for Na‐Ion Batteries
pmc-12559453.creator: Anastasia Grebenshchikova, Jacob Olchowka, Loïc Simonin, Sergey Yaroslavtsev, Mathieu Duttine, François Fauth, Lorenzo Stievano, Christian Masquelier, Laurence Croguennec
pmc-12559453.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). One of the challenges in the energy transition is minimization of the battery cost for energy grid storage. Na‐ion batteries are a promising alternative to Li‐based analogues thanks to low cost, abundance of constituents, and an already set‐up industry. However, already commercialized positive electrode materials for Na‐ion batteries (Na3V2(PO4)2F3 and NaxCu1‐y‐zFeyMnzO2) contain critical raw elements such as V, Cu, and Mn, boosting the research towards abundant Fe‐based materials.

pmc-12562972.title: Development of the Medial Longitudinal Arch of the Foot in Czech Pre- and Primary School Children—A Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal Approach
pmc-12562972.creator: Jakub Novák, Jan Novák, Anna Vážná, Petr Sedlak, Reinald Brunner
pmc-12562972.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: The medial longitudinal arch (MLA) is initially masked by a fat pad that makes the foot appear flat. In preschool age, this fat pad resorbs, and the arch becomes more defined. The exact age at which the arch attains its final form remains uncertain due to high inter-individual variability and differing assessment methods, which complicates the distinction between physiological development and potential abnormalities.

pmc-13125129.title: Laetiporus sulphureus polysaccharides mitigate colitis by reshaping the gut microbiota and regulating immune responses
pmc-13125129.creator: Sharafat Ali, Yamina Alioui, Imran khan, Hidayat Ullah, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Aamna Atta, Mohammed Abusidu, Muhammad Ilyas, Uzma Noor, Renzhen Ma, Muhsin Ali, Nabeel Ahmed Farooqui, Ting Deng, Guangyang Wang, Yi Xin, Shanshan Sha, Yufang Ma
pmc-13125129.description: BackgroundInflammatory bowel disease (IBD) involves epithelial barrier disruption, immune dysregulation, and microbial imbalance. pmc-13253077.title: Isolated scrotal skin laceration following dog bite complicated by post-traumatic chronic scrotal pain: A case report
pmc-13253077.creator: Maachi Youssef, Boustani Amine, Amine Salim Lalaoui, Slaoui Amine, Karmouni Tariq, Koutani Abdellatif, Elkhader Khalid
pmc-13253077.description: BackgroundGenital dog bite injuries are rare but potentially severe. While most literature-reported cases describe testicular injuries and significant tissue loss, isolated scrotal skin lacerations represent a less severe clinical entity.Case presentationWe report a 32-year-old male with an isolated skin laceration of the scrotum due to a dog bite, without any testicular involvement on clinical and ultrasonographic evaluation.

pmc-13361105.title: TIM-3 in AML: a janus-faced orchestrator of immune exhaustion and leukemic self-renewal
pmc-13361105.creator: Ahmed Hjazi
pmc-13361105.description: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) remains a therapeutic challenge due to relapse driven by therapy-resistant leukemic stem cells (LSCs) and a profoundly immunosuppressive microenvironment. The immune checkpoint T-cell immunoglobulin and mucin-domain containing-3 (TIM-3) emerges as a uniquely Janus-faced orchestrator in AML pathogenesis.

pmc-13408093.title: Development and validation of single-item experience sampling measures of wellbeing in teens
pmc-13408093.creator: T R A Kral, C D Wilson-Mendenhall, R Jacobucci, R J Davidson, R Tatar
pmc-13408093.description: What are you feeling right now? Were you aware of where your mind was a moment ago? Questions like these provide simple, face valid measures of momentary experience. Ultra-brief measures using the experience sampling method (ESM), consisting of a few items that can be completed in about a minute, may also be highly scalable and increase engagement in applied contexts.

pmc-13433327.title: Prevalence and correlates of probable anxiety and depression among young people: A subnational cross-sectional study in Ghana
pmc-13433327.creator: Joyce Aputere Ndago, Emmanuel Asampong, Franklin N Glozah, Faustina Hayford Blankson, Philip Teg-Nefaah Tabong, Adanna Uloaku Nwameme, Philip Baba Adongo, Benedict Weobong, Malay Mridha, Anum Nisar, Siham Sikander, Dixon Chibanda, Siham Sikander, Dixon Chibanda
pmc-13433327.description: We assessed the prevalence of probable depression and anxiety among young people in Ghana to inform evidence-based responses to youth mental health needs. This subnational high-risk population survey was conducted among 602 young people (YP) aged 13–24 years across three ecological zones of Ghana. Screening was done using the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) and Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD-7) tools.
